fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.description: Identifies a physical vehicle, such as a bus or an individual train car. If possible, this should match internal agency asset and vehicle IDs. Note that identifiers in operational data streams (including GTFS-realtime) may refer to either an individual vehicle or a consist; those operational identifiers are documented in vehicle_assignments.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: Start of the date range for which operational data may reference this vehicle.

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: End of the date range for which operational data may reference this vehicle.

fields.name: vehicle_group_id
fields.title: ID referencing vehicle_groups.vehicle_group_id
fields.description: Identifies the vehicle group whose attributes apply to this vehicle.

fields.name: vehicle_label
fields.description: The public identifier that is shown on the vehicle (e.g., the bus number)

fields.name: license_plate
fields.description: The text of the license plate on the vehicle.

name: vehicles.schema.json
description: Physical vehicles, including buses and individual train cars.
